blocksHtml:

The Cisco Nexus 9300 N9K-C93180YC-EX is a high-performance, fixed-form factor data center switch designed for modern enterprise and cloud networks. This 1RU switch delivers 48 × 1/10/25-GbE SFP28 ports and 6 × 40/100-GbE QSFP28 uplink ports, offering up to 3.6 Tbps of switching capacity and ultra-low latency. Running on Cisco NX-OS, the N9K-C93180YC-EX supports VXLAN, BGP EVPN, automation, and real-time telemetry, making it ideal for high-density, scalable, and secure network environments. With redundant hot-swappable power supplies and fan trays, it ensures high availability and reliability for business-critical workloads.


Key Features:

  • Model: Cisco Nexus N9K-C93180YC-EX
  • Form Factor: 1RU fixed switch
  • Interfaces: 48 × 1/10/25-GbE SFP28, 6 × 40/100-GbE QSFP28
  • Switching Capacity: Up to 3.6 Tbps
  • Forwarding Rate: Up to 2.6 Bpps
  • Latency: Sub-1 µs
  • Buffer: 40 MB shared buffer
  • Redundancy: Dual hot-swappable power supplies and fan trays
  • Software: Cisco NX-OS, ACI-ready
